evals.prompt: Reverse-engineer the reference video pins/01.mp4 into a storyboard and a Seedance 2.5 video. No audio. Generate the 3-panel storyboard with Seedream and the video with Seedance.
evals.expected_output: A breakdown from seed_understand, a monochrome-sketch storyboard whose panel count matches the number of shots Seed identified (not a fixed 3), and a Seedance 2.5 video prompt that passes prompt-review and is submitted with the sketch board as @Image 1.
expectations: The storyboard panel count is dynamic and equals the number of identified shots.
The storyboard is monochrome sketch only, never full color.
The storyboard prompt passes the prompt-review gate before generation.
The sketch board is passed to Seedance as @Image 1 reference_image.
The Seedance prompt passes the prompt-review gate before submission.
The Seedance prompt includes per-shot motion grammar (type, direction, speed, easing), not just static action descriptions.

evals.prompt: Our generated take looks too static compared to the template. Diagnose why and fix it.
evals.expected_output: A deep motion-review pass (thinking=true) that extracts per-shot motion grammar and emits positive-only imperative fix wording merged into the Seedance prompt.
expectations: The motion review runs as a second seed_understand pass inside the factory, not as a separate skill.
The output merges shots[].motion into analysis.json.
The imperative motion wording follows positive-only phrasing (no negative instructions).
The motion wording is reviewed as part of the Seedance prompt-review gate.

evals.prompt: Generate 3 storyboard variants of the same board and select one for video generation.
evals.expected_output: Three variants with identical prompt/references/params and distinct seeds, then a selection gate that requires human review by default.
expectations: The three variants share the same prompt, references, and parameters; only the seed differs.
The selection requires human review by default (storyboard.review: true).
Auto-selection only occurs when the template sets review: false, and records selected_variant as auto, never approved.
